revisions.reason: Merge review 20261127 CPU opts onto main (origin/main incl. GPU stream d6 process bridge + opt/stack-audit 9862ed624 + opt/gm-fold3 4799b4da1): both branch-side host-file reviews were anchored to pre-merge hashes and are folded here unchanged in substance. Branch reviews: [Merge review 20261127 opt/stack-audit (origin/main + uop-opt/uop-sse dfde581b4 + opt/gm-fold2 420e05ad1): the branch-side reviews below were written against a pre-merge hash and are re-anchored here unchanged; main-side edits to this producer keep their own reviews. Review 20261125 --uop-opt=MASK: set_uop_opt joins the inherited setters, a compile-time choice per instance with the same lifetime as set_uop_sse. Review 20261126 --uop-sse-native (opt-in, off by default, only with --uop-sse): the uop tier gains native SSE ops 120-142 that run the 06c handler arm inline on the XMM file (memory forms through 109's window guard and service op), and the host plumbs set_uop_sse_native like set_uop_sse. No EIP write, callback frame, guest stack, HWND lifetime, hook or message delivery changed; callback ownership remains pending. Re-anchored on the uop-opt review at the opt/uop-flags merge (both sides kept: uop-opt ops 111-113 and set_uop_opt, SSE-native ops 120-142 and set_uop_sse_native). Review 20261126 GM fold: worker-imports adds the set_gm_fold/get_gm_fold decode-time mask to the inherited setter list, beside set_delphi_fold; no host entry, run call or callback boundary changes. General callback ownership remains pending. Review 20261127 GM collision fold: comment only -- the set_gm_fold mask's default is now 0x1F; the inherited setter list, host entries, run calls and callback boundaries are unchanged. General callback ownership remains pending.] [Review 20261127 GM collision-event fold: comment only -- the set_gm_fold mask's default is now 0x3F (bit 5 the collision-event pass); the inherited setter list, host entries, run calls and callback boundaries are unchanged. General callback ownership remains pending.]
